answers.reason: The full professor is a member of the university, but participation in the senate is not explicitly assigned to them based on their faculty-level role.
The budget planning round is handled by university leadership and administration, not by a full professor.
The full professor holds a chair and is part of the academic staff dealing with professorship matters.
Professors are core members of the faculty and participate in faculty-level bodies.
Professors are involved in teaching and degree programmes at the faculty level.
Examination boards deal with student examination matters, which are handled by administrative and specific faculty roles.
As a research group leader, the full professor takes part in research funding decisions.
Professors participate in module and degree programme matters within their faculty.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled by specific administrative or technical staff rather than professors.
Orientation week planning is typically organized for and by students or specific support staff.
